headline: Investigation permit request for former SPK Chairman Ömer Gönül
summary: Istanbul prosecutors cited clear indications that former Capital Markets Board chairman İbrahim Ömer Gönül failed to supervise investment funds properly. They applied to the Treasury and Finance Ministry for permission to investigate him for abuse of office.
why: The Capital Markets Board (SPK) regulates Turkey's securities markets and investment funds, so investigations into its leadership affect investor confidence in local oversight.
